study_info.title: Effects of Intensive Glucose Lowering in Type 2 Diabetes
study_info.authors: The Action to Control Cardiovascular Risk in Diabetes Study Group; Hertzel C. Gerstein, M.D., M.Sc., Michael E. Miller, Ph.D., Robert P. Byington, Ph.D., David C. Goff, Jr., M.D., Ph.D., J. Thomas Bigger, M.D., John B. Buse, M.D., Ph.D., William C. Cushman, M.D., Saul Genuth, M.D., Faramarz Ismail-Beigi, M.D., Ph.D., Richard H. Grimm, Jr., M.D., Ph.D., Jeffrey L. Probstfield, M.D., Denise G. Simons-Morton, M.D., Ph.D., William T. Friedewald, M.D.
study_info.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
study_info.study_design: Randomized, multicenter clinical trial; double two-by-two factorial design; random assignment of 10,251 patients to intensive or standard therapy groups.
study_info.inclusion_criteria: Type 2 diabetes mellitus and a glycated hemoglobin level of 7.5% or more and either were between the ages of 40 and 79 years and had cardiovascular disease or were between the ages of 55 and 79 years and had anatomical evidence of significant atherosclerosis, albuminuria, left ventricular hypertrophy, or at least two additional risk factors for cardiovascular disease (dyslipidemia, hypertension, current status as a smoker, or obesity).
study_info.exclusion_criteria: Frequent or recent serious hypoglycemic events, unwillingness to do home glucose monitoring or inject insulin, a body-mass index of more than 45, a serum creatinine level of more than 1.5 mg per deciliter (133 μmol per liter), or other serious illness.
study_info.study_setting: Multicenter clinical study conducted in 77 clinical centers across the United States and Canada.
study_info.source_of_recruitment: 77 clinical centers (aggregated within seven networks) across the United States and Canada.

minimal_units.intervention_details: Comprehensive intensive therapy targeting a glycated hemoglobin level of less than 6.0%. Patients in the intensive-therapy group attended monthly visits for the first 4 months and then every 2 months thereafter, with at least one interim phone call, with the aim of rapidly and safely reducing glycated hemoglobin levels to below 6.0%. Additional visits were scheduled as needed to achieve glycemic goals.
minimal_units.intervention_frequency: monthly visits for the first 4 months and then every 2 months thereafter, with at least one interim phone call

minimal_units.control_details: Standard therapy targeting a glycated hemoglobin level of 7.0 to 7.9%. Patients in the standard-therapy group had glycemic-management visits every 4 months.
